summary: P.I.N.E. argues that current CIPA rules do not protect children from harmful content in school‑provided research databases and calls for stronger filtering and enforcement. P.I.N.E. argues that current CIPA implementation is inadequate for E‑Rate‑funded research databases, calling for expanded filtering, vendor certification, and clarification that allow‑listing does not satisfy CIPA. P.I.N.E. opposes treating filter‑on‑the‑open‑web certification as complete when a homework database is bypassed.
